ado-net-lessons.title: ADO.NET Introduction
ado-net-lessons.description: Overview of ADO.NET, its architecture, and its role in .NET applications.

ado-net-lessons.title: Dataset
ado-net-lessons.description: Understanding Datasets in ADO.NET and their usage in disconnected data access.

ado-net-lessons.title: Transactions
ado-net-lessons.description: Concepts of database transactions and how ADO.NET handles them for data integrity.

ado-net-lessons.title: Cancellation Token, LINQ
ado-net-lessons.description: Using Cancellation Tokens in ADO.NET operations and integrating LINQ for data manipulation.

ado-net-lessons.title: LINQ
ado-net-lessons.description: Exploring LINQ in ADO.NET, including querying databases with LINQ-to-SQL and LINQ-to-Entities.

ado-net-lessons.title: Database First Model With Entity Framework
ado-net-lessons.description: Implementing the Database First approach in Entity Framework within ADO.NET applications.

ado-net-lessons.title: Code First Model With Entity Framework
ado-net-lessons.description: Using the Code First approach in Entity Framework to define and manage databases programmatically.

ado-net-lessons.title: Many To Many Relationships
ado-net-lessons.description: Handling many-to-many relationships in ADO.NET with Entity Framework and database design considerations.

ado-net-lessons.title: FluentApi, IUnitOfWork
ado-net-lessons.description: Using Fluent API in Entity Framework and implementing the Unit of Work pattern for data management.

ado-net-lessons.title: Dapper
ado-net-lessons.description: Introduction to Dapper, a lightweight ORM for ADO.NET, and its advantages over Entity Framework.

ado-net-lessons.title: Dapper Relationships
ado-net-lessons.description: Managing relationships in Dapper, including handling one-to-many and many-to-many mappings.

ado-net-lessons.title: Dapper Practise
ado-net-lessons.description: Hands-on practice with Dapper, including query optimization and best practices.
